name: New Business
summary: How a client opens a new insurance contract: open it, link a campaign, capture the client, pick benefits, set up collection, validate everything together, then activate so the contract is in force.

steps.name: Open contract
steps.description: The agent starts a new contract. It gets its next contract id and begins in status NEW.

rules.text: A contract is created once, here, and every later step adds to it.

steps.name: Link campaign
steps.description: The agent links the sale to a marketing campaign.

rules.text: A campaign must be linked, and it must be active, before the contract can be activated.

steps.name: Capture client details
steps.description: The agent captures the person who owns the contract.

rules.text: The contract must have an owner.
The owner's mandatory personal details must be complete.

steps.name: Link benefits
steps.description: The agent selects the benefits the client wants. Each benefit adds to the premium.

rules.text: At least one benefit must be selected.
Every selected benefit must be active.
The same benefit cannot be added twice.

steps.name: Capture collection details
steps.description: The agent records how and when premiums are collected.

rules.text: A valid collection method is required: debit order, EFT, card, payroll or cash.
The collection day must be valid: 1 to 31, and 1 to 28 for recurring monthly methods.

steps.name: Validate new business
steps.description: Before activation every rule is checked together and the result comes back as structured findings.

validation.pass: All rules passed. Ready for activation.
validation.fail: Validation failed. The contract stays NEW.

rules.text: The premium must be greater than zero.
The contract must still be in status NEW.
No duplicate active contract may exist where that is prohibited.
Each finding carries a rule code, severity, message and the field to fix.

steps.name: Activate contract
steps.description: Activation moves the contract from NEW to IN-FORCE. It only works if validation passed.

rules.text: Only a validated contract in status NEW can be activated. Otherwise it stays NEW.
Only a supervisor or administrator can activate.

openQuestions: Which role may override a failed validation, if any?
